x: This was held at Maidenhead on November 8th and as in 1949 at the same venue, we had the second man home in the individual race. P.

Notable absentees included previous winners in Vern Blowfield and Len Herbert, and we had Eric Herbert running in the Civil Service race on the same day. Len Adams, who has recently married, and Archie Bedford, also P.

As the winning team is barred from competing again, it will be seen that fresh men have constantly to be found and we think our post-war record speaks for itself. We thought we should improve on last year's 7th position, but as we were without P.
